projectDescription: The Smart Child Health Box is an IP65, solar-powered IoT device featuring an ESP32-S3 with 4G/LoRa/GPS and environmental sensors for PM2.5/CO2, temperature, humidity, UV, rain, light, and occupancy. Powered by 18650 batteries, it includes an OLED display, status LEDs, and a rugged wall-mount enclosure for rural health monitoring.

imagePromptSnapshot.description:
Project idea: use the modal model and design of the product in this image URL (https://img-cdn.flux.) to create Smart Child Health Box with the following features; create a simple hardware design of The Smart Child Health Box (SCHEB) is a low-cost child climate-health protection system built for African schools, clinics, and rural communities. It’s an integrated child climate-health intelligence system that combines smart hardware, AI software, and community action tools into one unified platform designed for rural and underserved communities. Instead of running multiple disconnected solutions, SCHEB merges disease forecasting, environmental sensing, and emergency preparedness into a single ecosystem focused on protecting children from climate-sensitive health threats.
. It is designed to be mounted on the wall while its mini solar is mounted outside. It houses sensors for temperature, humidity, air quality (PM2.5/CO₂), UV radiation, rainfall, ambient light, and optional occupancy monitoring. Powered by a rechargeable battery with an integrated solar panel, it supports Wi-Fi, GSM/4G, LoRa, Bluetooth, GPS, and offline data storage for continuous operation. The enclosure is a durable, weather-resistant (IP65-rated) ABS/polycarbonate case with ventilation ports protected by filters, a small LCD/OLED status display, LED alert indicators, and a carry handle for portability. Its modular design allows easy sensor replacement, maintenance, and future upgrades without replacing the entire unit. Also design the case, note that solar panel is not attached to the product, also the product should come with height of 10 inches, width of 4 inches and length of 6 inches and will have 18650 lithium battery slot, mini antennal and mini screen that displays temperature, humidity, air quality (PM2.5/CO₂), UV radiation, rainfall, ambient light, and optional occupancy monitoring. it should have a wall hanger as its designed for users in rural areas and it should come with a single PCB. Adhere strictly too this design specification: 1. Component Technical Specifications
A. The External 5W Solar Panel Assembly
	Dimensions: Approximately 10" in"×7" in"×0.7" in"  (250" mm"×180" mm"×17" mm" ).
	Frame: Corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum frame with pre-drilled mounting holes.
	Mounting Bracket: Heavy-duty tilt-adjustable wall/roof mounting arm (allows 360^∘ rotation and 90^∘ tilt to optimize angle relative to the equator).
	Cabling: A 3"m"  to 5"m"  UV-resistant, double-insulated cable pre-installed via an IP67 junction box on the back of the panel. It terminates in a threaded, waterproof male DC barrel connector (5.5" mm"×2.1" mm" ).
B. The SCHEB Enclosure (Wall-Mounted)
	Form Factor: 10" in"  Height, 4" in"  Width, 6" in"  Length/Depth.
	Wall Mounting Mechanism: A heavy-duty sliding mounting plate. The plate is screwed directly into the concrete, brick, or wooden school wall. The SCHEB unit then slides downward onto the plate and locks in place with a security screw at the bottom to prevent theft.
	Cable Entrance & Drip Loop: The DC input port is positioned on the top or upper-side edge. It is recessed and features a threaded mating collar to lock the solar panel cable in place. The cable should be installed with a "drip loop" (a downward U-bend) just before entering the building to prevent rainwater from running down the cable and into the wall hole or the device port.
2. Internal Structural Layout (Single PCB & Battery Slot)
Inside the 10×4×6"-inch"  enclosure, the architecture is partitioned to optimize thermal isolation and RF performance:
	The Backplate: Features the guide rails for the sliding wall hanger. Inside, the 18650 lithium battery slot is integrated directly onto the back wall or the lower half of the single PCB, keeping the heaviest component securely anchored close to the wall.
	The Single PCB: Mounted vertically.
	Top Section: House the wireless RF modules (GSM/4G, LoRa, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth) closest to the top-mounted external SMA antenna to minimize signal loss.
	Middle Section: Houses the main microcontroller, power management unit (MPPT charger), and connects directly to the front-facing mini screen.
	Bottom Section: Holds the environmental sensors (PM2.5, CO₂, Temperature, Humidity). This places them directly above the bottom louvered air vents, isolated from any rising heat generated by the power regulation circuitry or the cellular transmitter.

Design notes: compact form factor, rugged design, solar-powered, IoT device, weather-resistant IP65, modular design, 18650 battery slots, mini antenna, mini screen, wall hanger, single PCB, 10x4x6 inch dimensions

Electrical components (current): Main Controller (mcu, 18x25.5x3mm); 6x module: GSM/4G Module, LoRa Transceiver Module, GPS Module, Mini GSM/4G Antenna +2 more; 5x power: MPPT Solar Charge Controller, 18650 BMS for 2S/3S, 18650 Li-ion Battery Cell, 18650 Li-ion Battery Cell +1 more; 6x sensor: Temperature & Humidity Sensor, PM2.5 & CO2 Sensor, UV Index Sensor, Rainfall Sensor +2 more; 3x display: OLED Status Display, Red Alert LED, Green Alert LED

Mechanical/structural parts (current): 5x enclosure: SCHEB Main Enclosure, Enclosure Front Panel, Top Ventilation Grille, Bottom Ventilation Grille +1 more; 3x structural: SCHEB Wall Mounting Plate, External 5W Solar Panel Assembly, Solar Panel Mounting Bracket; 8x misc: Security Screw for Wall Mount, Dust Filter for Top Vent, Dust Filter for Bottom Vent, DC Input Cable Gland +4 more; 20x 3d_printed: Internal Backplate/PCB Frame, 18650 Battery Slot 1, 18650 Battery Slot 2, Vertical PCB Mount +16 more

Assembly: SCHEB Main Enclosure → Enclosure Front Panel (M4 enclosure screws and adhesive weather seal for IP65); SCHEB Main Enclosure → SCHEB Wall Mounting Plate (Sliding mechanism, locks with security screw); SCHEB Main Enclosure → Security Screw for Wall Mount (M4 screw for theft prevention); SCHEB Main Enclosure → Top Ventilation Grille (Integrated/snap-fit into enclosure opening); SCHEB Main Enclosure → Bottom Ventilation Grille (Integrated/snap-fit into enclosure opening); Top Ventilation Grille → Dust Filter for Top Vent (Snap-fit/press-fit); Bottom Ventilation Grille → Dust Filter for Bottom Vent (Snap-fit/press-fit); SCHEB Main Enclosure → Carry Handle (M4 screws/integrated mounts); SCHEB Main Enclosure → DC Input Cable Gland (Threaded into enclosure top/side opening with seal); Internal Backplate/PCB Frame → SCHEB Main Enclosure (M3 screws to internal standoffs); Vertical PCB Mount → Internal Backplate/PCB Frame (Guide rails and M3 screws); RF Module Standoffs → Vertical PCB Mount (M2 screws for module mounting); OLED Display Bezel → Enclosure Front Panel (Snap-fit/M2 screws from inside); Red LED Mount → Enclosure Front Panel (Snap-fit/press-fit); Green LED Mount → Enclosure Front Panel (Snap-fit/press-fit) (+33 more connections)

plan:
- Main components: ESP32-S3 MCU with LoRa/LTE/GPS, 18650 Li-ion batteries, MPPT solar charge controller, PM2.5/CO2, Temp/Humidity, UV, Rainfall, Ambient Light, PIR sensors, OLED display, status LEDs.
- Communication: Integrated Wi-Fi, GSM/4G, LoRa, Bluetooth, GPS, with external mini antennas.
- Enclosure: Weather-resistant IP65 ABS/Polycarbonate (10x4x6 inches) with integrated ventilation, dust filters, recessed DC input with cable gland, and carry handle.
- Mounting: External 5W solar panel with adjustable mounting bracket, and a heavy-duty sliding wall mounting plate for the main unit with security screw.
- Internal structure: Single vertical PCB, 3D-printed internal backplate with integrated 18650 battery slots and sensor mounts, internal thermal partitioning.

tools: Screwdriver set (Phillips, Flat, Security Torx for M4)
Drill and drill bits (for antenna/cable gland holes)
assumptions: Basic soldering proficiency for component connections.
Familiarity with microcontroller programming environments (e.g., Arduino IDE, PlatformIO).
Access to a computer with serial communication software for debugging.
Ability to troubleshoot basic electrical circuits.
Appropriate power supply for initial testing (e.g., 5-12V DC bench power supply).

subSteps.title: 3D Print all custom mounting brackets and bezels
Prepare SCHEB Main Enclosure for component integration
Install ventilation grilles and dust filters
Attach carry handle to the main enclosure
Solder all power connections (DC Jack, Solar Charge Controller, BMS, Main MCU)
Solder UART and Power connections for Cellular, GPS, and PM2.5/CO2 Modules to Main MCU
Solder SPI and Power connections for LoRa Module to Main MCU
Solder I2C and Power connections for Temperature/Humidity, UV, Ambient Light, and OLED Display
Solder GPIO and Power connections for Rainfall Sensor and Occupancy Sensor
Solder Alert LEDs and their power/GPIO connections
Connect RF modules to their respective mini antennas
Perform continuity check on all soldered power and data lines
Upload base firmware to Main Controller and verify power rails
Test I2C sensors and OLED Display for correct recognition and data output
Test UART modules (Cellular, GPS, PM2.5/CO2) for communication and data reception
Verify SPI communication with LoRa module
Test GPIO-based sensors (Rainfall, Occupancy) and Alert LEDs
Initial battery charging test via DC input and solar panel
Mount Main Controller and other modules to their 3D printed mounts
Mount sensors and OLED display to their respective 3D printed mounts and bezels
Install 18650 batteries into their slots and integrate BMS/Charge Controller
Mount PCB frame and vertical mounts inside the main enclosure
Install DC barrel jack, antenna mounts and cable gland into enclosure openings
Route all internal wiring, ensuring strain relief and proper organization
Mount external solar panel assembly to its bracket and connect cable
Secure enclosure front panel with weather seal and screws, then attach wall mounting plate
